[b][u]UPDATED COMPLETE!!

PlsBuffSeraphine's almost DCBurger's style Portrait for Adventurer's Guild Expanded

[/u][/b]I create these portraits because I love DCBurger's style. When I play AGE and search for portraits that match DCBurger's style, I can't find any. Therefore, I have to take matters into my own hands and dust off my graphics tablet from Limbo.

I can't quite achieve the exact DCBurger's style. So, I've added a twist and incorporated my own art style, resulting in something that almost resembles DCBurger's style.

PS. For those who use CP, I apologize that I don't know how to mod, so the portraits will only be available in PNG format for Portraiture. Sorry!
